modules.title: Bring beloved storybook moments to life in this beautiful coloring book filled with 40+ princess-themed scenes to color.
modules.text:
Inside this incredibly detailed coloring book, more than 40 iconic scenes from the Disney Dreams Collection by Thomas Kinkade Studios feature princesses known for their courage, kindness, perseverance, and sense of wonder. From dreamers and adventurers to leaders and loyal friends, these characters continue to resonate with fans through the strength of their hearts as much as the magic of their stories. 
With full-color reference images and intricate line art throughout, this enchanting book offers a relaxing and creative way to celebrate the timeless appeal of Disney’s most cherished heroines. 
Ideal for Disney collectors, coloring hobbyists, or anyone seeking a calming activity, this coloring book is a wonderful keepsake to treasure or gift.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I love Thomas Kincade. His artwork is so soft and elegant and these books (I now have two of them) are just as sweet as his artwork. I love the idea that they give you (on one side) ideas on colors by having a fully colored page and on the other side, at first glance, is an identical page for you to color. However, if you look closely, as you are coloring, you will notice they actually aren't identical, there are spots that are different. I really like this fact because then you have to add your own ideas for colors into the picture, instead of copying exactly what these authors have done (which I don't anyways). I just use their color skeem for ideas if I'm stuck on what color I should use. I definitely would buy these again and can't wait until I can find the other two in this set.
